caption:
Most owners think they need to hire more people.

They need fewer decisions and more systems.

Run this 3-question test on every repeatable task in your business this week: missed-call callbacks, appointment reminders, review requests, quote follow-ups.

Same every time. Timing over judgment. Works on a bad day. Two of three means the task belongs to a system.
